title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
body: Now hold on.
Because Tyler Perry done got the band back together and y'all know good and well we're about to be stressed.

The original Why Did I Get Married? had everybody arguing in living rooms, group chats, beauty salons and cookouts. Folks took sides, lost friendships, and suddenly became relationship experts overnight.
And now we're doing it again?
My question isn't who's married.
My question is who's cheating.
Because Tyler Perry never brings people together just to let them be happy.
One thing about Tyler, if everybody smiling in the first act, start praying.
take: Somewhere an auntie already got her wine glass ready and an opinion nobody asked for.

title: Is God Is
body: Baby.
The cast alone has my attention.
You got Janelle Monáe. You got Sterling K. Brown. And if you've seen the stage play, then you already know this ain't one of those sit-back-and-fold-laundry movies.
This is revenge.
This is family drama.
This is trauma in a trench coat.
The title sounds spiritual but don't be fooled. Everybody isn't headed to church.
Some folks are headed to settle scores.
take: I don't know what's about to happen, but I know somebody's peace is getting disturbed.

title: Jumanji 3
body: At this point I'm convinced nobody learns lessons in the Jumanji universe.
Every movie starts the same way.
A mysterious game appears.
Someone says don't touch it.
Somebody touches it.
Then everybody spends two hours fighting for their lives.
And somehow we're all seated opening weekend.
take: If I see a magical board game in real life, I'm minding my business and going home.

title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
body: Can we all agree that Panem needs therapy?
Because every few years they find a new way to traumatize children and somehow we keep buying tickets.
But let's be honest.
We're gonna watch.
The Hunger Games hasn't missed yet.
The odds may never be in your favor, but the casting department stays employed.
take: If my city picked kids by lottery for anything, I'm moving immediately.
